sync.title: Offline and sync
sync.description: Save private records on this device and review changes before they reach the server.

sync.operationError: The operation needs attention. Check the details or retry when connected.
sync.discardExplanation: This discards the queued local change and reloads the current server record. Dependent changes may still need review.
sync.resolveError: The change could not be applied. Refresh and review the latest server version.
sync.serverDeleted: This record has been deleted or is unavailable on the server.
sync.reviewDescription: Compare the queued fields with the server copy before choosing a resolution.
sync.recordPending: This record has changes awaiting synchronization.
sync.filesExplanation: Choose individual files in the private vault. Removing an offline copy leaves the cloud original available.
sync.noFiles: No documents have been selected for offline use.
